episodes.synopsis: Normura is transferred to a new school, and the Supreme Five Swords are more than ready to give him the welcoming tour.
episodes.title: The Magnificent Blade, Rin Onigawara

episodes.synopsis: The Junior Five Swords take it upon themselves to get revenge on Nomura. Meanwhile, Rin gets an unexpected visit.
episodes.title: The Chastity Dorm Riot

episodes.synopsis: Nomura gets on Mary's bad side after messing with Choka. Meanwhile, Rin is trying to get her own revenge.
episodes.title: The Fair Sword, Mary Kikakujo

episodes.synopsis: Rin and Mary have their eyes set on Nomura and are fighting for his affection. The only thing Warabi wants to do is take down Nomura!
episodes.title: The Warabinpics are Starting!

episodes.synopsis: Warabi seeks revenge against Nomura, and she won't stop: even if it means going against Rin and Mary.
episodes.title: The Love-Crazed Blade, Warabi Hanasaka

episodes.synopsis: Mary and Rin don't hold back in their battle against Nomura. In the meantime, Warabi has her own plans to set in motion.
episodes.title: Notes on a Scandal

episodes.synopsis: Satori sets her eyes on Nomura and isn't ready to let him off easily. In the meantime, Nomura tries to find a way out of Satori's clutches.
episodes.title: The Dubious Sword, Satori Tamaba

episodes.synopsis: Nomura is finally freed from Satori's grasp. With some help from the other swords, Rin and Nomura are able to open up to each other.
episodes.title: His and Crossdressing Her Circumstances

episodes.synopsis: When Amo catches wind of the little setup Satori did to Nomura, Amo challenges her. As the fight begins, Satori realizes that she's in way over her head.
episodes.title: The Day Love Died

episodes.synopsis: Satori and Amou's fight continues on the school's rooftop. Meanwhile, Nomura is challenged by Inaba in the courtyard.
episodes.title: The Terrifying Blade, Tsukuyo Inaba

episodes.synopsis: Amou and Nomura's fight bring back memories of their past. Meanwhile, the girls are starting to put together the mystery that is Amou.
episodes.title: The Magic Bullet I'll Always Remember

episodes.synopsis: As the battle continues, Nomura doesn't hold back, and someone seems to have a personal interest in the fight.
episodes.title: The Girls' Machiavellism
